title: Hello World
text:
This is the first post on my new website, built with Quarto and org-mode.


I write content in org-mode, my preferred authoring format. A Makefile converts org files to Quarto markdown using pandoc, then Quarto renders the site.
make preview  # converts + renders + serves locally




Org-mode for writing - unmatched for literate programming and notes
Quarto for publishing - beautiful defaults, good math/code support
GitHub Pages for hosting - free static hosting with CI/CD




I'll be sharing work on:

Operations research and optimization
Machine learning in production
The political economy of algorithms

title: About
text:
Research Interests

Optimization & Operations Research: Mathematical programming, network optimization, multi-objective optimization
Machine Learning: Production ML systems, model deployment, scalable inference
Political Economy of Optimization: How objective functions encode political choices, equity vs efficiency trade-offs
Infrastructure Networks: Energy grids, port logistics, supply chain optimization
